title: Nullpoint win BPL Legends Stage 2026
body:
[[Nullpoint]] are the [[BPL Legends Stage 2026]] champions.

**The run.** On the way to the final they got past Crystal Laurels 2-0 (group b · round 1), [[Mourningstar]] 2-0 (group b · round 2), [[Bluebird]] 2-1 (group b · round 3), [[Moonlit Tempo]] 2-0 (group b · round 4) and [[Pastel Mocha]] 2-0 (group b · round 5).

**The MVP.** [[TearsofDeath]] was the standout player of the event, with a 1.27 rating over 11 maps, 226 kills and 38 MVP rounds.

**The roster.** The title-winning line-up: [[candybar_isblue]], [[UtsuhoNull]], [[zhizyii]], [[Kaito_Oshino]] and [[ssseiso]].

The title is worth 250 BPL points and Nullpoint now sit #5 in the BPL ranking.

title: Pastel Mocha are the Phase Shift Invitational I champions
body:
[[Pastel Mocha]] are the [[Phase Shift Invitational I]] champions. They beat [[Eiromancers]] 2-1 in the final to lift the trophy.

**The run.** On the way to the final they got past [[Team Neverseen]] 2-0 (quarterfinals) and [[Lunar Cadence]] 2-0 (semifinals).

**The MVP.** [[kenzieyii]] was the standout player of the event, with a 1.24 rating over 7 maps, 148 kills and 20 MVP rounds.

**The roster.** The title-winning line-up: [[Niamocha]], [[kenzieyii]], [[pastellows]], [[RDarius]] and [[ItzSune]].

The title is worth 250 BPL points and Pastel Mocha now sit #30 in the BPL ranking.
